console.footer.tagline: Mesh telemetry for operators. Built by Sensical SCCL in Barcelona.
page.home.hero.title: The world's first <accent>storage and data solution for Meshtastic</accent>
page.home.hero.subtitle: Keep mesh inventory, gateway permission and channel history in one place, <highlight>without a spreadsheet export.</highlight>
page.home.cta.title: Know the mesh by tonight.
page.home.cta.subtitle: Sign in to the console, create a mesh, and watch the first packets land.
page.home.footer.tagline: Storage and a console for Meshtastic networks. Built by Sensical SCCL in Barcelona.
page.home.faq.heading: Fair questions, <secondary>straight answers.</secondary>
page.home.faq.meshtastic.a: A storage and data layer for Meshtastic networks: meshes, gateways, nodes and the telemetry they produce.
page.home.faq.cookies.q: Do I need a cookie banner to use the product?
page.home.faq.cookies.a: This marketing page sets no analytics cookies. The console uses a session cookie after you sign in, so that the API knows who you are.
page.home.faq.globe.a: No. It is a sample mesh over the western Mediterranean, drawn so you can see hops between gateways and nodes.
page.home.faq.signIn.a: Anyone can register an owner account. A new account stays inactive until you confirm the email address you signed up with.
page.home.extras.heading: The radio stays LoRa. <secondary>The history lives here.</secondary>
page.home.extras.storage.title: Storage for the mesh
page.home.extras.storage.body: Keep node identity, last seen, and readings next to the mesh they belong to.
page.home.extras.gateways.title: Gateways you allow
page.home.extras.gateways.body: A registered gateway is permission to decode. Disallow it and that traffic stops being stored.
page.home.extras.channels.title: Channels and charts
page.home.extras.channels.body: Latest values as cards, then a series when you pick a channel, a window and an aggregation.
page.home.extras.operators.title: Built for operators
page.home.extras.operators.body: One owner login. Meshes, devices and blueprints in a single console.
page.home.extras.identity.title: Node identity
page.home.extras.identity.body: Short name, role and last packet, without turning the radio into a user profile.
page.home.extras.position.title: Position when you want it
page.home.extras.position.body: Store location packets with the device they came from. The globe on this page is a sample, not live traffic.
page.home.extras.blueprints.title: Blueprints
page.home.extras.blueprints.body: Attach post-processing to a device when the raw channel is not the number you read.
page.home.extras.noBanner.title: No banner on this page
page.home.extras.noBanner.body: The marketing page sets no analytics cookies. The console uses a session cookie after you sign in.
page.home.extras.lora.title: The radio stays LoRa
page.home.extras.lora.body: This is storage and a console. The mesh keeps running the way you already run it.
page.home.features.heading: Know the mesh, the gateways, <secondary>and the channels they carry.</secondary>
page.home.features.inventory.title: Realtime inventory
page.home.features.inventory.description: Last seen, role and readings next to the mesh they belong to.
page.home.features.gateways.title: Gateways you allow
page.home.features.gateways.description: A registered gateway is permission to decode.
page.home.features.channels.title: Channels and charts
page.home.features.channels.description: Pick a channel, a window and an aggregation.
page.home.steps.heading: Three steps from a mesh to a chart, <secondary>and the first one is a name.</secondary>
page.home.steps.registerMesh.title: Register a mesh
page.home.steps.registerMesh.description: Create a mesh, keep the PSK on the gateways, and the rest of the nodes join that radio network.
page.home.steps.packetsLand.title: Packets land in storage
page.home.steps.packetsLand.description: Allowed gateways decode traffic. Telemetry, position and nodeinfo are stored as they arrive.
page.home.steps.readBack.title: Read it back
page.home.steps.readBack.description: Open a mesh, a device, or a channel series. The inventory is the live picture of the radio.

page.terms.title: Terms and Conditions
page.terms.acceptance.heading: Acceptance of these terms
page.terms.acceptance.body: By creating an owner account you agree to these terms and to our handling of your data as described below.
page.terms.use.heading: Use of the service
page.terms.use.body: Meshtastic Things is a storage and console layer for Meshtastic networks. You are responsible for the meshes, devices and data you register under your account.
page.terms.accounts.heading: Accounts and email verification
page.terms.accounts.body: A new account stays inactive until you confirm the email address you registered with. You are responsible for keeping your password and API keys confidential.
page.terms.data.heading: Data
page.terms.data.body: Telemetry and configuration you submit is stored to operate the service and is not sold to third parties.
page.terms.termination.heading: Termination
page.terms.termination.body: You may delete your account at any time from the console. We may suspend accounts that abuse the service.
page.terms.changes.heading: Changes to these terms
page.terms.changes.body: We may update these terms as the product evolves. Continued use of the service after a change constitutes acceptance.
page.terms.contact.heading: Contact
page.terms.contact.body: Questions about these terms can be sent to Sensical SCCL through the contact page linked in the footer.
